faq.title: What people ask us before getting started.

items.q: How long does it take to implement Zentral?
items.a: On average 3 weeks from project kickoff. It depends on the number of modules and the complexity of your operation. Our Indrox team supports the whole process.

items.q: Can I start with just a few solutions?
items.a: Yes. Zentral is a modular suite: each solution is purchased separately and connects with the rest. Many companies start with Zentral Commerce + Workplace and add Finance, People or Supply as they grow. Indrox helps you pick the right starting package for your industry.

items.q: Does it integrate with accounting systems and SUNAT?
items.a: Yes. Zentral integrates with the main accounting systems in the Peruvian market and generates the reports SUNAT requires.

items.q: What if I need something that isn't in the standard solutions?
items.a: Indrox can build custom submodules and flows on top of any of the 8 solutions. That's part of our value prop: we don't squeeze you into a generic SaaS, we extend Zentral to fit your real operation.

items.q: How is it different from Odoo?
items.a: Odoo is powerful but complex, slow to implement and needs specialized consultants. Zentral is designed to be implemented in weeks, not months, with local support and AI built in from day one.

items.q: Is there support in Spanish and for LATAM?
items.a: Yes. Zentral and the Indrox team operate from Peru. We understand the reality of LATAM SMBs: SUNAT, electronic invoicing, local payments, informal processes and everything international ERPs ignore.
